```python
import selfies as sf
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Descriptors
s='[C][O][C][Ring1][Ring1][C][C][C][Ring1][Ring1][C][C][C][Ring1][Ring2]'
sm=sf.decoder(s)
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm)
print('decoded_smiles',sm)
print('canonical_smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print('formula',Descriptors.MolecularFormula(m) if hasattr(Descriptors,'MolecularFormula') else Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'bonds',m.GetNumBonds())
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=7)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
xyz=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); xyz.append((a.GetSymbol(),(p.x,p.y,p.z)))
from pyscf import gto, scf
mol=gto.M(atom=xyz,basis='sto-3g',charge=0,spin=0,unit='Angstrom')
myhf=scf.RHF(mol).run(verbose=0)
moe=myhf.mo_energy
occ=myhf.mo_occ
homo=max(e for e,o in zip(moe,occ) if o>0)
lumo=min(e for e,o in zip(moe,occ) if o==0)
print('SCF_converged',myhf.converged)
print('HOMO_Hartree',float(homo))
print('LUMO_Hartree',float(lumo))
print('gap_Hartree',float(lumo-homo))
print('gap_eV',float((lumo-homo)*27.211386245988))
```
